_about: (0.4.8, gamefixes: the journal redone) How the journal files every quest the world offers (rpg.quest.QuestLog). Each authored quest's entry: its title, whether it is a 'main' or a 'side' quest, who gives it, what it asks of the player before it can be taken ('requires': a combat level, a skill's level), a line saying what it is, and where its giver and its goal are (resolved from the world by the entity ids in rpg.Ids). Warrants taken from a watch board ('warrants') are side quests made by the world: their title is the fugitive's name, their goal the last place the watch saw them. 'colors' are the list's: red for a quest not begun, yellow for one under way, green for one done (grey for one failed).

courier.title: Courier
courier.summary: A sealed letter to be carried, unopened, from one hand to another.

warrants.title: Warrant: %s
warrants.summary: A signed warrant from the watch of %s for %s, %d gold on their head. The mark on the map is where the watch last saw them; they may have moved.
